domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains transactional columns standard in retail e-commerce datasets: InvoiceNo, StockCode, Quantity, UnitPrice, InvoiceDate, CustomerID, and Country, indicating transactional sales records.

kpi_specs.name: Total Sales Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the total monetary value of all transactions in the dataset.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_sales FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total sales is the primary baseline financial metric for retail. A single metric card is the best way to visualize this high-level aggregate.

kpi_specs.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the average spend per individual transaction (invoice).
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) / COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS average_order_value FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: AOV measures purchasing behavior and order efficiency. A single key performance indicator card allows stakeholders to monitor order-size health instantly.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Sales Trend
kpi_specs.description: Tracks total retail revenue performance month-over-month to identify seasonal trends.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS invoice_month, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS monthly_revenue FROM data GROUP BY invoice_month ORDER BY invoice_month
kpi_specs.reasoning: Line charts are the optimal visual standard for depicting continuous chronological trends and evaluating periodic growth rates.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Countries by Sales Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Identifies the highest revenue-generating geographical markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS country_revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY country_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: A bar chart highlights the comparative distribution of revenue across categorical attributes, allowing easy identification of top performing regions.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Best-Selling Products by Quantity
kpi_specs.description: Identifies the top 10 products based on total unit volume sold, accompanied by total revenue generated.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT StockCode, Description, SUM(Quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS product_revenue FROM data GROUP BY StockCode, Description ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: A table is appropriate for viewing granular item attributes (such as descriptions and stock codes) in a ranked list side-by-side with numerical metrics.
